<thought>Search the template catalog for more candidates by specifying only the broken functional group (aryl halide) and increasing the result limit to 20. This will return additional templates that may produce the exact precursors COc1ccccc1N and Nc1cc([N+](=O)[O-])cc([N+](=O)[O-])c1O when applied to the target molecule.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "COc1ccccc1Nc1cc([N+](=O)[O-])cc([N+](=O)[O-])c1O",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["aryl halide"],
    "limit": 20
}</action_input>
